# P31.17 — Human review campaign for camera-site resolution (HUMAN-H4)

- **Marker id:** `HUMAN-H4` · **Kind:** human · **Phase:** 31 · **Wave:** gated tail
- **Blocks:** P31.18 (skeleton; its body cannot be written until real human labels exist). It blocks nothing else:
  **a pause, not a block**. The chain continues to P31.19, and this marker sits in RETURN PASS until dispositioned.
- **Gate register:** human work (curators + operator). Precondition of **D-R6.1-EVAL** and of the human-decision half of
  **D-P30.2b-1**.

> **Operator/curator work — NOT an `implement-spec` input.** Engineering built the surface (P31.10) and the
> clustering wiring (P31.11). What remains is real human judgement. No agent or LLM label counts toward this

## Checklist
- [ ] Decide **who adjudicates** (the operator, the P29.1 vetted curators, or both) and issue tier tokens (ADR-100; no accounts, no PII). <!-- design §6 Q11 -->
- [ ] Fix the **sample design** with engineering: proposed ~400 stratified pairs (≈150 across auto tiers 1g/3g for a Wilson 95% lower bound near 0.98, plus 4g/5g proposals, soft conflicts, and disputed/adjudicator-disagreement buckets); seed recorded; drawn by `sig-resolution review sample` (P31.10).
- [ ] Adjudicate the sample in the loopback curation app (P31.10) or via `review export`/`import`; target ≥ 2 independent reviewers on a κ subsample.
- [ ] Record the campaign outcome in `docs/build/LEDGER.md § GATE DECISIONS` and `docs/build/readouts/HUMAN-H4.md` (counts, reviewers by pseudonymous id, inter-reviewer κ, dates).
- [ ] Hand off to engineering: the hosted camera-sites re-run that clusters the accepted decisions, and the D-P30.2b-1 closure, are owned by **P31.18** (engineering, not human work).

## Exit criterion
The sample is adjudicated and recorded, so P31.18 can be written and run against a human holdout. Or the operator
consciously skips it (recorded), and D-R6.1-EVAL stays OPEN with this marker as its landing.
